Name: Switchboard
Author: Moving Average Labs
Description: Switchboard — an operator's control surface for macOS. Live key faces show whether Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions are working or need you (tmux, iTerm2, or Terminal.app; press to raise them) — plus Safari tab jump, window tiling and cycling, tmux panes, BBEdit documents, and files.

Actions.Name: Safari Tab Jump
Actions.Tooltip: Jump to an open Safari tab, or open it if missing. Hold to capture the current tab.

Actions.Name: Scroll Window
Actions.Tooltip: Dial: scroll the frontmost window. Press: jump to top (or toggle speed). Tap: toggle fast/slow.

Actions.Name: Open / Switch App
Actions.Tooltip: Open or switch to an app, optionally focusing a window by title pattern. Hold to capture the frontmost app.

Actions.Name: Focus tmux Window
Actions.Tooltip: Raise the iTerm2 window for a tmux window, and optionally switch to it. Hold to capture the current tmux window.

Actions.Name: Switch tmux Pane
Actions.Tooltip: Dial: rotate to switch tmux panes, or windows after a press/tap toggles the mode.

Actions.Name: Cycle tmux Window
Actions.Tooltip: Dial: rotate to cycle tmux windows; push for last window; tap to widen the scope to all sessions.

Actions.Name: Cycle App Windows
Actions.Tooltip: Dial: cycle the frontmost app's windows. Press or tap: toggle to cycling apps instead.

Actions.Name: BBEdit Documents
Actions.Tooltip: Dial: move between the open documents in BBEdit's front window. Press: back to the previous document.

Actions.Name: Open File
Actions.Tooltip: Open the newest / latest / pattern-matched file in a folder, with a live ✓/✗ status badge.

Actions.Name: Paste Snippet
Actions.Tooltip: Press to insert the stored text; hold to capture the current selection into the key. Uses ⌘C/⌘V in most apps, but saves your clipboard first and puts it back afterwards — including images and files. It won't copy a clipboard your password manager marked secret, and it refuses password fields it can detect, though not all of them.

Actions.Name: Window Ring
Actions.Tooltip: Long-press to add/remove the current window; tap to cycle through your saved windows.

Actions.Name: Arrange Window
Actions.Tooltip: Dial: rotate to tile the frontmost window through the active arrangement (reverse retraces it). Tap: toggle arrangement A/B. Press: maximize.

Actions.Name: AI Project
Actions.Tooltip: Replaces the separate Claude/Codex/Cursor Project keys. Live face for a Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor CLI session (cursor-agent in the terminal, not the Cursor editor) — hold while one is frontmost and it works out which. Press to raise its terminal and exact tmux pane. A red edge stripe marks a turn that finished while you were looking elsewhere; going to that session clears it.

Actions.Name: Claude Project (legacy)
Actions.Tooltip: Superseded by AI Project, which auto-detects the agent. Live face for a Claude Code project; press to raise its window, hold to capture the frontmost session. Will be removed in a future release.

Actions.Name: Codex Project (legacy)
Actions.Tooltip: Superseded by AI Project, which auto-detects the agent. Live face for an interactive Codex CLI session; press to raise its terminal and exact tmux pane. Will be removed in a future release.

Actions.Name: Cursor Project (legacy)
Actions.Tooltip: Superseded by AI Project, which auto-detects the agent. Live face for an interactive Cursor CLI session; press to raise its terminal and exact tmux pane. Will be removed in a future release.
